diagnostics.message: The Compile items are not what the SDK's glob gives (the glob adds src/Billing.Tool/Legacy/Old.cs); the explicit list is kept with EnableDefaultCompileItems=false.

The PostBuildEvent is now the PostBuild target (AfterTargets="PostBuildEvent"). Review it: macros such as $(TargetPath) keep their meaning, but paths relative to the output folder change with the SDK's bin/<configuration>/<framework>/ layout.
